description: devbox.json and devbox.lock are ignored because the devbox parity job (truvity/ci-workflows docs/devbox-update.md) owns them: it moves the devbox packages and the lockfile together in one pull request, and a Renovate bump of either file alone would leave them disagreeing. The pinned Pkl in bin/pkl is not a Renovate dependency: a bump is a reviewed change of the version and four checksums together, and `just vuln` checks the checksums against GitHub's.
